findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/codex-adapter-checks.ts:303-320 and packages/main/src/handlers/codex-adapter.ts:33-42: Codex gate evidence is only the latest codex_adapter_verification event with result=pass, and verify_codex records no headHash/materialHash/check snapshot freshness marker. REVIEW/DONE gates therefore pass on stale Codex evidence after later Codex adapter/.Codex/bin changes, violating CHK-005 adversarial stale-evidence intent. Bind the event to current HEAD/material hash or rerun checks in the gate so stale evidence becomes missing/failing.

README.md:90, README.md:106, .Codex/README.md:34-35, packages/main/src/init-assets.ts:98-99, AGENTS.md:104 tell Codex users to run bare `koala verify_codex` / `koala init --verify-codex`, but the current global `koala verify_codex --help` returns '未知命令' and global `koala init --help` omits --verify-codex; the repository wrapper exposes `node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex`, and init help advertises `npx koala-init --verify-codex`. WHY: users following the user-facing docs can fail the Codex adapter REVIEW/DONE evidence path before reaching the command that actually exists in this repo/bootstrap. Severity high because it blocks the exact gate evidence flow this story documents.

packages/main/src/core/codex-adapter-checks.ts:303 and packages/main/src/handlers/codex-adapter.ts:36 expose koala verify_codex as the remediation/evidence command, but the installed/global koala in this worktree returns unknown command for verify_codex while node bin/koala.js verify_codex and node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex pass. For users on the documented global fallback/core-only path, the REVIEW/DONE gate hint is not executable, so the adapter boundary is not honest about local wrapper vs installed global constraints.

README.md:68-107 and .Codex/README.md:30-42 describe Codex activity, verify_codex, init verification, and runtime exclusions, but they do not document the live diagnostic path `node bin/koala-codex.js doctor`; running `node bin/koala-codex.js doctor --format=json --limit=1` shows it returns the shared Codex adapter check block, including telemetry heartbeat, aux availability, and excluded .Codex/hooks/settings. WHY: when `verify_codex` or gates report adapter drift, users lack the documented doctor command that surfaces the same checks plus health/worktree diagnostics from the Codex wrapper entrypoint. Severity medium because verify_codex is documented, but doctor is the requested troubleshooting surface and is currently undiscoverable in the user-facing Codex docs.

CHK-003 happy evidence names the user-facing command `koala verify_codex`, but a focused run in the story worktree returns `未知命令: verify_codex`; only `node bin/koala.js verify_codex` passes. This leaves the documented/gate hint command unverified and currently unusable through the actual `koala` entrypoint in this environment. Evidence: `koala verify_codex` failed; `node bin/koala.js verify_codex` passed. Files: scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs, packages/main/src/handlers/codex-adapter.ts, README.md

CHK-002 edge says telemetry derives session from CODEX_SESSION_ID, OPENAI_SESSION_ID, TERM_SESSION_ID, or KOALA_ACTIVITY_SESSION consistently, but `scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs` only proves CODEX_SESSION_ID and explicit KOALA_ACTIVITY_SESSION behavior; OPENAI_SESSION_ID and TERM_SESSION_ID are only present in manifest/docs assertions. Add focused runtime assertions for those fallback env vars. Files: scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs, bin/koala-codex.js

Several adversarial/gate intents are marked covered by healthy-path checks or docs_check only: `npm run test:codex-assets` verifies the current repo has no forbidden assets and matching manifest, but does not create `.Codex/hooks`, `.Codex/settings.json`, or manifest drift and assert doctor/verify failure; CHK-005 gate evidence is code/docs inspection rather than a focused missing/failing/stale codex_adapter_verification preflight/DONE block test. Add negative-path tests for forbidden assets, manifest drift, missing/failing/stale gate evidence. Files: scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs, packages/main/src/core/codex-adapter-checks.ts, packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts, packages/main/src/handlers/story-advance.ts

packages/main/src/core/codex-adapter-checks.ts:285 and packages/main/src/handlers/story-advance.ts:483 accept the latest codex_adapter_verification pass without checking it against the current HEAD/material hash. WHY: a story can run koala verify_codex, then change Codex adapter code/docs/templates, and REVIEW/DONE still consume the stale passing event as hard evidence. severity=high because the new gate can be bypassed by normal post-verification edits.

packages/main/src/cli-init.ts:138 generates bin/koala-codex.js as spawnSync("koala", ...), while bin/koala-codex.js:20 in this repo imports the local bootstrap. WHY: initialized projects document the wrapper as the local Codex entry that loads bootstrap/main+utils, but the generated wrapper falls back to whatever global koala is on PATH, so core-only or stale global installs can miss aux_doc_list/verify_codex and produce different telemetry. severity=medium because new-project Codex sessions become environment-dependent.

scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs:15 now delegates to runCodexAdapterChecks, which does not inspect .Codex/README.md or root README.md/AGENTS.md, while README.md:93 still says npm run test:codex-assets checks those docs. WHY: docs/template drift can pass the named regression test, leaving future Codex adapter guidance unguarded and making the verification contract misleading. severity=medium because it is a regression in maintainability coverage rather than runtime behavior.

packages/main/src/cli-init.ts:125-169 and packages/main/src/cli-init.ts:593-597 generate only bin/koala-codex.js, but the generated wrapper needs a sibling bin/koala.js to be a true local bootstrap and init --verify-codex skips wrapper heartbeats when that sibling is absent. WHY: a fresh initialized project can pass npx koala-init --verify-codex while its recommended node bin/koala-codex.js session_brief exits with “did not find a sibling bin/koala.js” whenever a capable global koala is not on PATH; this keeps new-project Codex sessions environment-dependent instead of verified. Evidence: temp init plus PATH=/usr/bin:/bin node <tmp>/bin/koala-codex.js session_brief exited 1.
